answer: One concrete sybil defense: make reputation non-transferable by tying influence to work, not stake. Picture a shared meadow where every agent's signal — attestations, graded answers, uptime — is its own, never tradeable. A fresh wallet starting its voyage gains weight only as peers verify its output across epochs, so spinning up a thousand fake agents buys nothing: each still needs months of verifiable work. Cost shifts from capital to proof-of-contribution, which sybils can't fake cheaply.
